sentences.en: In the United States, a tablespoon is equivalent to three teaspoons.
sentences.zh: 在美国，一汤匙相当于三茶匙。

sentences.en: Add two or three tablespoons of sugar and pour boiling water.
sentences.zh: 加入两到三汤匙糖，然后倒入沸水。

sentences.en: Did you add a tablespoon of salt? The recipe called for just a teaspoon!
sentences.zh: 你加了一汤匙盐吗？食谱上只要求放一小茶匙！

senses.zh: 大汤匙，大调羹,一大汤匙的量
